title: وزير الداخلية: التقييد السكاني أصبح خدمة عمومية دائمة تضمن حق جميع المواطنين في التسجيل
why: Interior minister gives population register enrolment figures (3.4m in 2019 to over 5.1m) tied to civil status services; one agency holds both (levels 2-4).

title: Agence Nationale du Registre des Populations et des Titres Sécurisés
why: ANRPTS presentation: one national biometric register and NNI across civil status and ID, with health connection; enrolled counts (levels 2-4).

title: Rapport de mise en oeuvre de la SCAPP pour l'année 2024
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances, Mauritanie
why: Reports no system covering all births, a pilot for real-time birth and death registration in health facilities awaiting funding, and registry connection to other systems (levels 0-1).

title: Etat-civil : Le ministère adopte plus de verrous pour la Mauritanité
why: New civil status law: birth declared within 60 days and NNI issued only after nationality verification (birth declaration and NNI linked, level 2-3).

title: برنامج هويتي يبدأ العمل ويؤمن جميع أنواع مستخرجات الحالة المدنية
why: ANRPTS statement: Houwiyeti app issues digital birth, marriage, divorce and death extracts and the digital ID from one account (levels 2-3).

title: Enrôlement au registre de la population d'un enfant né de parents mauritaniens
publisher: Portail des Procédures et Formalités Administratives, Ministère de l'Intérieur
why: Procedure enrolling a newborn in the biometric population register from a health-facility birth extract (births enrol people, level 3).

title: TOR Digital Identity Pilot in Mauritania
why: States ANRPTS holds the civil register and population database, about 80% enrolled and about 24% of under-5s with birth certificate (levels 2, 4).

title: Inauguration du nouveau système de gestion du registre des populations et des titres sécurisés
why: New integrated system: biometric national register plus production of secured titles including civil status acts (level 2).
